t.zh: 一台理想的针孔相机：场景里一点发出的光，只有穿过小孔的那一条落到像平面上。三维的场景就这样被压成一张二维的图（<wiki-ref to="image-formation-3d-to-2d"></wiki-ref>）。穿过小孔、垂直于像平面的那条线叫光轴：点偏离光轴多远记作 X，它的像偏离光轴多远记作 u。
t.en: An ideal pinhole camera: of all the light a scene point sends out, only the ray through the hole reaches the image plane. That is how a 3D scene is pressed into a 2D picture (<wiki-ref to="image-formation-3d-to-2d"></wiki-ref>). The line through the hole square to the image plane is the optical axis: how far a point is off it is X, how far its image is off it is u.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：点在哪里，它的像就落在哪里？先在相机台上移动一点，让像落进圆圈；再把你找到的关系接成一块电路，以后要投影就直接用它。
t.en: This level asks: where a point is, where does its image land? First move a point on the camera bench until its image lands in the circle; then wire the relation you found into a circuit, to use whenever something must be projected.

desc.zh: 输入物点的横向位置 X、距离 Z 和像平面距离 f，输出像点位置 u
desc.en: Takes a point's sideways position X, its distance Z and the plane distance f; gives the image position u

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>：u = fX/Z。距离加倍，像就缩一半；真相机为了进光够多装上镜头，但成像关系不变。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>: u = fX/Z. Twice as far, half the image; real cameras add a lens for light, but the relation holds.

brief.zh: f = 2，点离小孔 Z = 4：横向移动这一点，让它的像落在 u = 1。
brief.en: f = 2, the point Z = 4 from the hole: move it sideways so its image lands at u = 1.

hint.zh: 顺着画出的光线看：它从点出发，穿过小孔，停在像平面上。像平面离小孔多远，点又离小孔多远？
hint.en: Follow the drawn ray from the point through the hole to the plane. How far is the plane from the hole, and the point?

why.zh: 把点放在 X = 1，像却只落到 u = 0.5：光线穿过小孔后，横向位置按 f/Z = 2/4 缩小了一半。
why.en: With the point at X = 1 the image lands at u = 0.5 only: through the hole, the sideways position shrinks by f/Z = 2/4, to half.

t.zh: 这一步接一块电路：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去，测试和隐藏测试都对才算对。
t.en: This step wires a circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right; it is right when every test and hidden test is.

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

hint.zh: 台子上 Z 加倍时，像离中心近了多少？f 加倍呢？
hint.en: On the bench, how much nearer the centre did the image come when Z doubled? And when f doubled?
